_comment: Hand-kept (2026-09-29, user request: noob-friendly rotations, class spells only). The short leveling rotation a new player follows, per class and fight-lab spec model (the model a leveling build plays in fightlab/run.py). Each list is the fight lab's priority (the module's DESCRIPTION and its casts per kill in research/leveling/rotation.md) in plain words; the exact priority stays on the research pages. Edit when a class module's priority changes. render_modes.py prints them on the leveling player pages.

before: Levels 10-19: Bear Form. From 20: Cat Form, then Prowl (stealth) up behind the mob.
steps: Levels 10-19 (bear): **Enrage**, **Demoralizing Roar**, then **Maul** whenever you have the rage.
From 20 (cat), open from Prowl with **Ravage** (**Pounce** before 32, **Claw** before that), then **Tiger's Fury**.
**Rake** once.
**Claw** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Rip** on a mob with plenty of health, **Ferocious Bite** on one that is nearly dead.
between: Low on health: leave Cat Form and cast **Regrowth** or **Rejuvenation**, then shift back.
Drink when your mana is below a third.

before: Moonkin Form once you have it.
steps: **Moonfire** and **Insect Swarm** on the mob.
**Wrath** while the mob walks in.
**Starfire** when Eclipse lights up or the mob is rooted or stunned, **Wrath** otherwise.
Low on health: **Entangling Roots** on the mob, then **Regrowth**.
between: Drink when your mana is below a third.

before: Pet out (a cat), **Aspect of the Hawk** up.
Send the pet in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Hunter's Mark** and **Serpent Sting**.
**Bestial Wrath**, **Intimidation** and **Rapid Fire** at the start when they are ready.
**Aimed Shot** or **Multi-Shot** whenever ready (they share a cooldown), **Arcane Shot** or **Summon Hawk** in between.
**Auto Shot** does the rest. Keep your distance: the bow cannot fire within 8 yards.
**Mend Pet** when the pet drops below a third of its health.
If a mob reaches you: **Wing Clip** and **Raptor Strike**, or **Feign Death**.
between: Mend the pet, drink below a third of your mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: Pet out (a cat), **Aspect of the Hawk** up.
Send the pet in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Hunter's Mark** and **Serpent Sting**.
**Rapid Fire** at the start when it is ready.
**Aimed Shot** or **Multi-Shot** whenever ready, **Arcane Shot** in between.
**Auto Shot** does the rest. Keep your distance: the bow cannot fire within 8 yards.
**Mend Pet** when the pet drops below a third of its health.
If a mob reaches you: **Wing Clip** and **Raptor Strike**, or **Feign Death**.
between: Mend the pet, drink below a third of your mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: Pet out, **Aspect of the Monkey** (**Aspect of the Beast** once you have it).
**Hunter's Mark** and **Serpent Sting** from range, then walk in.
steps: **Immolation Trap** at your feet while the mob has most of its health.
**Mongoose Bite** when it lights up (after a dodge).
**Counterattack** after you parry.
**Strider Kick** on cooldown.
**Raptor Strike** on every swing it is ready.
Low on health: **Deterrence**; **Mend Pet** for the pet.
between: Mend the pet, drink below a third of your mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (later **Ice Armor** or **Mage Armor**) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: **Frostbolt** while the mob walks in (it slows it).
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back.
**Ice Lance** (or **Frostbolt**) while it is frozen.
Finish a nearly dead mob with **Fire Blast** or your wand.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when you are out, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (later **Mage Armor**) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: **Fireball** while the mob has more than a fifth of its health.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back.
**Fire Blast** whenever ready; **Scorch** only when you have plenty of mana.
Finish a nearly dead mob with your wand.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when you are out, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (later **Mage Armor**) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: **Frostfire Bolt** while the mob walks in.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back.
**Ice Lance** while it is frozen, **Fire Blast** whenever ready.
Finish a nearly dead mob with your wand.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Ice Armor** and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Gather several mobs (about four) before you fight.
steps: **Frost Nova** when they reach you, then step back out of melee.
**Blizzard** on the group; **Cone of Cold** when they close in again.
**Arcane Explosion** if they are on top of you.
Single leftovers: **Ice Lance** / **Frostbolt**, wand to finish.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when you are out.

before: **Frost Armor** (later **Mage Armor**) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can; **Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind** at the pull when they are ready.
steps: **Arcane Blast** twice while the mob walks in (each cast makes the next one cost more; stop at two).
**Arcane Missiles** after the Arcane Blasts, and at once when Missile Barrage lights up (not on a mob that is nearly dead).
**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back.
Finish a nearly dead mob with **Fire Blast** or your wand.
Low on mana: **Frostbolt** instead of Arcane Blast.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when you are out, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Blessing of Might** and **Devotion Aura** up, a two-handed weapon.
Before each pull: **Seal of Command** (**Seal of Righteousness** before you have it).
steps: **Judgement** and **Holy Strike** whenever ready.
**Consecration** while your mana lasts.
**Hammer of Justice** when you are hurt (or to set up a big Judgement).
**Hammer of Wrath** when the mob is below 20% health.
Low on health: **Divine Protection** and **Holy Light**; **Lay on Hands** in an emergency.
between: Heal yourself back to 80% with **Holy Light** or **Flash of Light**, drink below a third of your mana.

before: **Blessing of Wisdom** and **Devotion Aura** up, a two-handed weapon.
**Seal of Righteousness** before each pull.
steps: **Holy Shock** the mob as it walks in (while your mana is high).
**Judgement** and **Holy Strike** whenever ready.
Keep **Seal of Righteousness** up.
Low on health: **Holy Shock** on yourself, **Divine Protection**, **Hammer of Justice**, then **Holy Light**; **Lay on Hands** in an emergency.
**Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells.
between: Heal yourself back up with **Holy Light**, drink below a quarter of your mana.

before: **Blessing of Might** and **Devotion Aura** up, a one-handed weapon and a shield.
**Seal of Fury** before each pull (it also shields you).
steps: **Holy Shield** whenever it is down.
**Judgement** and **Holy Strike** whenever ready (**Swift Judgement** to reset Judgement).
Keep **Seal of Fury** up.
**Consecration** while your mana is above 60%.
**Hammer of Wrath** when the mob is below 20% health.
Low on health: **Templar's Bulwark**, **Divine Protection**, **Hammer of Justice**, then **Holy Light**; **Lay on Hands** in an emergency.
between: Drink below a sixth of your mana; you rarely need to eat.

before: **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** up; **Shadowform** once you have it.
**Power Word: Shield** on yourself before the pull.
steps: **Mind Blast** to pull.
**Shadow Word: Pain**.
**Vampiric Embrace** and **Devouring Plague** (they heal you).
**Mind Blast** whenever ready, **Mind Flay** in between (it slows the mob).
**Shadow Word: Death** when the mob is below 20% health.
Finish a nearly dead mob with your wand; **Psychic Scream** if your health gets low.
between: Drink below a third of your mana, eat below two thirds of your health (**Renew** outside Shadowform).

before: **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** up.
**Power Word: Shield** on yourself before the pull.
steps: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull.
**Penance** and **Mind Blast** whenever ready.
**Smite** in between while the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana; your wand otherwise.
Skip **Holy Fire**: its long cast costs more than it deals while leveling.
Hurt: **Renew**, **Flash Heal** below a third of your health; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are low.
between: Drink only below 15% mana; **Renew** yourself instead of eating.

before: **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** up.
**Power Word: Shield** on yourself before the pull; **Power Infusion** on yourself when it is ready.
steps: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull.
**Penance** and **Mind Blast** whenever ready.
**Smite** in between while the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana; your wand otherwise.
Skip **Holy Fire**: its long cast costs more than it deals while leveling.
Hurt: shield again, **Flash Heal** below a third of your health; **Psychic Scream** if you are in trouble.
between: Drink only below 15% mana; **Renew** yourself instead of eating.

before: **Instant Poison** on your main hand, **Deadly Poison** on your off hand.
Stealth up behind the mob.
steps: Open with **Cheap Shot** (**Garrote** before level 26).
**Slice and Dice** at 1-2 combo points when it is not up.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate** (**Kidney Shot** instead if you are below half health).
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Blade Flurry** and **Adrenaline Rush** at the start of a fight; **Evasion** when your health gets low.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below half.

before: **Instant Poison** on your main hand, **Deadly Poison** on your off hand.
Stealth up behind the mob.
steps: Open with **Cheap Shot** (**Garrote** before level 26).
**Slice and Dice** at 1-2 combo points when it is not up.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate** (**Kidney Shot** instead if you are below half health).
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Adrenaline Rush** at the start of a fight; **Evasion** when your health gets low.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below half.

before: Daggers in both hands, poisons on.
Stealth up behind the mob; **Premeditation** for two free combo points.
steps: Open with **Ambush** at low level, **Garrote** once you have it at 30 (it bleeds through armor).
**Ghostly Strike** whenever ready (it also makes you dodge more).
**Hemorrhage** (or **Sinister Strike** before you have it) to build combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate** (or earlier if it would kill the mob).
**Riposte** after you parry; **Evasion** when your health gets low (**Preparation** resets it).
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below half.

before: **Lightning Shield** up, **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon (**Windfury Weapon** from 30), a slow two-handed weapon.
Drop **Searing Totem** as you pull.
steps: **Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in.
**Stormstrike** whenever ready, then **Earth Shock**.
**Flame Shock** while your mana allows.
**Lightning Bolt** when Maelstrom Weapon reaches 5 stacks (it is instant).
Low on health: **Stoneclaw Totem** and **Lesser Healing Wave**.
between: Heal back to 80% health, drink below a third of your mana.

before: **Lightning Shield** up.
Pull from range with **Lightning Bolt**.
steps: **Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in.
**Flame Shock**, **Earth Shock** and **Lava Burst** whenever ready.
**Lightning Bolt** in between while your mana lasts.
between: Heal back to 80% health, drink below a third of your mana.

before: **Demon Skin** (later **Demon Armor**) up, **Summon Voidwalker**.
Send the Voidwalker in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony**, **Siphon Life** and **Immolate** on the mob.
**Wrack** once the damage-over-time spells are up.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have plenty of mana, your wand otherwise.
**Drain Life** when you are hurt, **Life Tap** when you are low on mana.
If a mob reaches you: **Fear** it or **Death Coil**.
between: **Life Tap** back to 70% mana, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** or **Health Funnel**, eat only below a third of your health.

before: **Demon Armor** up, **Summon Voidwalker**.
Send the Voidwalker in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Corruption** (not on a mob that is nearly dead), **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** on the mob.
**Searing Pain** to keep Demonic Brand up once you have it.
**Soul Fire** when Decimation lights up (mob below 35% health).
**Shadow Bolt** only when your mana is nearly full; your wand otherwise.
**Drain Life** when you are hurt, **Life Tap** when you are low on mana.
If a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** or **Fear**.
between: **Life Tap** back up, heal the Voidwalker with **Health Funnel**, eat only below a third of your health.

before: **Demon Armor** up, **Summon Voidwalker**.
Send the Voidwalker in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Corruption** (not on a mob that is nearly dead) and **Bane of Agony** while the Voidwalker grabs the mob.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana, then **Conflagrate** when Immolate is about to run out.
**Incinerate** on a burning mob while your mana is nearly full; your wand otherwise.
**Shadowburn** or **Conflagrate** to finish a mob they would kill.
**Life Tap** when you are low on mana.
If a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** (skip Fear and Drain Life: the Voidwalker takes the mob back).
between: **Life Tap** back up, heal the Voidwalker with **Health Funnel**, eat below 40% health.

before: **Battle Stance**, a two-handed weapon.
steps: **Bloodrage**, then **Charge** in.
**Battle Shout**: keep it up.
**Mortal Strike** whenever ready.
**Overpower** when it lights up (after a dodge).
**Rend** once.
**Execute** when the mob is below 20% health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage; **Victory Rush** after a kill.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below half.

before: **Battle Stance**, a weapon in each hand.
steps: **Bloodrage**, then **Charge** in.
**Battle Shout**: keep it up.
**Bloodthirst** whenever ready.
**Overpower** when it lights up (after a dodge).
**Execute** when the mob is below 20% health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage; **Victory Rush** after a kill.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below half.

before: A one-handed weapon and a shield, **Defensive Stance**.
steps: **Battle Stance**, **Charge** in, then back to **Defensive Stance**.
**Battle Shout**: keep it up.
**Shield Block** whenever the mob is hitting you.
**Revenge** whenever it lights up (after a block, dodge or parry).
**Shield Slam** whenever ready.
**Rend** once.
**Shield Bash** a mob that casts spells.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage; **Victory Rush** after a kill; **Concussion Blow** when you are hurt.
between: You rarely need to eat or bandage: the shield soaks most of the damage.
